_about: SAFETY.md decision 1, tool-level overrides: tools held to a stricter tier than their server annotations give. This is a policy decision, not a fact about the server - the annotations are still shown as the server declares them. Read by scripts/gen-tiers.mjs, scripts/check-docs.js and audit/matrix.mjs. A test fails if SAFETY.md and this file name different tools, or if the server starts annotating one of them destructive. Change the decision in SAFETY.md and here together.

create_order.label: T3 charges
create_order.why: Charges the card at once. The server does not annotate it destructive, but it moves money, and SAFETY.md puts every tool that moves money in T3.

create_subscription.label: T3 charges
create_subscription.why: Charges the first cycle to the card at once. The server does not annotate it destructive, but it moves money, and SAFETY.md puts every tool that moves money in T3.
